###empirical data
```{r}
dt <- fread("../../07empirical_results/04fst/anc_F0.sync.fst.gz")
dt_general <- dt[, 1:5]
colnames(dt_general) <- c("chr", "window_pos", "num_snp", "frac_snp", "average_cov")
temp_dt_fst <- dt[, 6:110]
new_dt_fst <- temp_dt_fst[, lapply(.SD, function(x)
  tstrsplit(x, "=", type.convert = TRUE)[[2]])]
setnames(new_dt_fst, sapply(temp_dt_fst[1], function(x)
  tstrsplit(x, "=")[[1]]))

dt_fst <- cbind(dt_general, new_dt_fst)

#average across the genome
col_mean_fst <- dt_fst[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = 6:110]
col_median_fst <- dt_fst[, lapply(.SD, median, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = 6:110]
emp_fst <- data.table(
  mean_fst = as.numeric(col_mean_fst),
  median_fst = as.numeric(col_median_fst),
  pair = names(col_mean_fst)
)
emp_fst[, c("groupA", "groupB") := tstrsplit(pair, ":", fixed = TRUE)]

get_group <- function(id) {
  id <- as.integer(id)
  if (id >= 1 && id <= 5) return("A")
  if (id >= 6 && id <= 10) return("B")
  if (id >= 11 && id <= 15) return("C")
  else return(NA_character_)
}

emp_fst[, group := mapply(function(r1, r2) {
  g1 <- get_group(r1)
  g2 <- get_group(r2)
  if (g1 == g2) g1 else paste0(sort(c(g1, g2)), collapse = "")
}, groupA, groupB)]

emp_fst[, comparison := ifelse(nchar(group) == 1, "within", "between")]
emp_fst[, ]
fwrite(emp_fst, file = "00Empirical_fst.txt.gz", sep="\t", quote = FALSE)
rm(col_mean_fst, col_median_fst,dt,dt_fst,dt_general,new_dt_fst,temp_dt_fst)
```


```{r}
cal_ave_fst <- function(run,loci){
  fst_file <- paste0("run",run,"_n400_",loci,"loci_s10.sync.fst.gz")
  dt <- fread(fst_file)
  dt_general <- dt[, 1:5]
  colnames(dt_general) <- c("chr", "window_pos", "num_snp", "frac_snp", "average_cov")
  temp_dt_fst <- dt[, 6:8]
  new_dt_fst <- temp_dt_fst[, lapply(.SD, function(x)
    tstrsplit(x, "=", type.convert = TRUE)[[2]])]

  setnames(new_dt_fst, sapply(temp_dt_fst[1], function(x)
    tstrsplit(x, "=")[[1]]))


  dt_fst <- cbind(dt_general, new_dt_fst)

  #average across the genome
  col_mean_fst <- dt_fst[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = 6:8]
  col_median_fst <- dt_fst[, lapply(.SD, median, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = 6:8]
  dt_ave_fst <- data.table(
    mean_fst = as.numeric(col_mean_fst),
    median_fst = as.numeric(col_median_fst),
    pair = names(col_mean_fst)
  )
  dt_ave_fst[, c("groupA", "groupB") := tstrsplit(pair, ":", fixed = TRUE)]
  dt_ave_fst[, run := run]
  dt_ave_fst[, num_target := loci]
  return(dt_ave_fst)
  
}

fst_simulation<-NULL
for (run in 1:10){
  for (num_target in c(10,100, 1000, 5000, 10000, 20000)){
    temp_fst<-cal_ave_fst(run, num_target)
    fst_simulation<-rbind(fst_simulation, temp_fst)
  }
}
fst_simulation[ , num_target := factor(num_target)]
fwrite(fst_simulation, file = "00fst_simulation.txt.gz", sep="\t", quote = FALSE)
```


```{r}


#empirical data
p_emp <- ggplot(emp_fst[comparison=="between",], aes(x = comparison, y = mean_fst)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_signif( comparisons = list(c("between", "within")), test = "wilcox.test", map_signif_level = TRUE) +
  #annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.0027, label = "Wilcox test\nP-value=0.0002046", color = "black", size = 4, hjust=0) +
  ylim(0, 0.006)+
  labs(x = "Comparison", y = "Mean Fst", title = "Empirical") +
  theme_bw() 
  #theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.95, 0.85))

#simulation
p_simu <- ggplot(fst_simulation, aes(x=num_target , y = mean_fst)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  ylim(0,0.006)+
  labs(x = "Number target", y = "", title = "Simulation") +
  theme_bw()

p_merge <- ggarrange(p_emp, p_simu,widths = c(1,2))
p_merge<-annotate_figure(p_merge,
                         top = text_grob("Ancestral Fst between supergroups", face = "bold", size=14))
plot(p_merge)
ggsave("Anc_Fst.pdf", plot = p_merge, width = 7, height = 7)
```
